name: Binzel Style MB 24KD Euro Connection MIG Welding Torch (3 Meter)
shortDescription: Ergonomic 250A gas-cooled MIG/MAG welding torch with universal Euro central connection, high-flex coaxial cable package, and ball-joint strain relief.
overview: The MB 24KD style MIG welding torch is the international industry standard for high-amperage gas metal arc welding on mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminium. Featuring a universal Euro central connector with spring-loaded contact pins, this torch connects seamlessly to virtually all modern MIG/MAG power sources. The ergonomic handle incorporates anti-slip rubber inserts, a responsive micro-switch trigger, and a ball-joint cable articulation that drastically reduces wrist fatigue during extended welding sessions. Engineered with heavy-duty brass front-end consumables and a high-efficiency coaxial power-gas cable, it delivers stable shielding gas flow and cool operation up to 250A.
keyFeatures: Universal Euro central adapter compatible with ESAB, Kemppi, Miller, and all standard machines
Rated 250A CO2 and 220A Mixed Gas (Ar/CO2) @ 60% duty cycle
Optimal torch cooling design extending front-end consumable life
Ergonomic handle with soft grip inserts and ball-joint pivot for maximum agility
Heavy-duty steel spring strain relief on both machine and handle ends
Includes heavy brass gas nozzle, M6 contact tip holder, and gas diffuser
High-tensile insulated coaxial cable withstands heavy drag and spatter
applications: Medium to heavy sheet metal fabrication
Automotive manufacturing and roll cage welding
Steel structural assembly and tank manufacturing
